articles.summary: Baker Hughes, an energy technology company, and H&P, a leading provider of drilling solutions and technologies, announced Wednesday a strategic collaboration to support geothermal exploration and development in the United States, including the contracting of a land drilling rig dedicated to geothermal activity.
articles.title: Baker Hughes and H&P Collaborate to Advance U.S. Geothermal Development

articles.summary: H&P has announced the recipients of the Women of H&P Awards, recognizing employees for leadership, professional growth and contributions across the organization. The awards honor women who demonstrate H&P’s values through their work and influence. Employees across the company were nominated by their peers, reflecting a broad range of impact and achievement.
